purpose: Record, at field level, whether bounded first-party SSE samples actually returned a H1 or H3 input, only exposed a disclosure/rule route, did not reveal the field, or still requires written authorization. This is not data acceptance, product due diligence, a replay, or a strategy result.

decision_boundary.allowed_next_step: source/right inquiry and data-contract design only

status_legend.已被样本访问到: A retained official response directly contains the field or a recognizable local record for the stated code/window/page only.
status_legend.只见规则路径: A rule, landing page, disclosure index, or PDF route is known, but no directly usable structured field sample was retained in this bounded probe.
status_legend.未见: The bounded request set did not reveal the field or a sufficient substitute. It does not prove the field does not exist elsewhere.
status_legend.需授权: Formal historical use still requires written rights, complete delivery, coverage explanation, retention/replay/derived-analysis permission and independent-review permission.

source_evidence.usable_fact: Fifteen small SSE response bodies record locally observed field availability for H1 and H3.
source_evidence.non_inference: They do not demonstrate completeness, point-in-time availability, rights, version lineage, replay readiness or execution feasibility.

source_evidence.usable_fact: Retains current SSE master-list and limited day-k samples for A-shares, REITs, ETFs and exchange bonds.
source_evidence.non_inference: Current/retrospective sample access is not a full historical population or a total-return/replay input.

source_evidence.usable_fact: Defines H1 and H3 input, event, execution and falsification requirements before any formal replay.
source_evidence.non_inference: A hypothesis definition does not admit a product or establish performance.

source_evidence.usable_fact: Separates venue rules from individual authorization, broker execution and settlement facts.
source_evidence.non_inference: A venue rule does not establish an account route or fillability.

formal_replay_gates.reason: No complete dual-venue/product-class lifecycle and daily status delivery.
REIT operations, ETF history/methodology, bond accrual/credit and full convertible-term chains are absent.
No individual eligibility, route, depth, fill, fee, tax or settlement evidence.

formal_replay_conclusion.reason: Both hypotheses fail mandatory PIT-population, field-version/available_at, event-ledger, rights and execution/cost/settlement gates. No performance calculation or candidate generation is permitted from these samples.

h1: Obtain an all-venue historical security universe with daily listing, delisting, status, halt and no-trade coverage.
Obtain structured financial fields with document hash, available_at, restatement/version and missing-data treatment.
Obtain a complete corporate-action/adjustment ledger and effective-dated execution/cost/settlement fields.
Obtain written rights covering retention, normalization, replay, derivative analysis and independent review.
h3: Obtain dual-venue historical product/bond masters and lifecycle reconciliation for every H3 class.
Obtain synchronized market-price, NAV/accumulated-NAV, IOPV, time-stamp, definition and revision data.
Obtain PIT REIT operating/expansion, ETF holdings/index-methodology, bond accrual/credit and full convertible-term/event ledgers.
Obtain product-specific trade state, depth, cost, tax, settlement, account-route and written data-use evidence.

prohibited_inferences: Do not treat ADDDATE, SSEDATE, appraisalDate, record date, ex-right date or local retrieval time as available_at without a source semantic and version record.
Do not treat a current master, a retrospective day-k window, PCF page, disclosure index or event snippet as a complete historical ledger.
Do not infer personal eligibility, fillability, cost, tax, settlement or a data-use right from public endpoint accessibility.
Do not derive a security list, product admission, allocation, holding, order, performance result or return claim from this artifact.
